parts.text: Deliveries carry a load from one site to another, and inspections take a drone with the right sensors to a list of points in a set order and bring it back to where the inspection started. Drones fly along corridors between named sites, and sites have only so many places where drones can take off and land at the same time. While the policy of our company is that software never chooses a drone or a way for them, I want help finding out which of my drones could get to where a job starts.
